research_question: Does server-observed math.find/math.run telemetry retain most useful trajectory-diagnostic information supplied by bounded user-visible agent messages, once task/input and final answer plus exact verifier outcome are already available?
prohibited_methods: text embeddings or text geometry fitted on the evaluation corpus
prompt, feature, label, task, or threshold tuning after labels are observed

observable_tuple.x: Frozen task instruction, input, public submission schema, and task metadata.
observable_tuple.y: Final user-visible agent message, submitted artifacts, and exact independent verifier reward plus diagnostic outcome.
observable_tuple.b: Non-final user-visible Codex agent_message items only, redacted and bounded to 512 UTF-8 bytes per message, 32 messages, and 8192 UTF-8 bytes per trial.
observable_tuple.tau_tools: Ordered server log events for math.find/math.run plus joined capability-attempt ID, version, execution status, assurance, diagnostic codes, timing, response size, and bounded request/argument digests. No tool arguments or results.

runtime.mcp_authentication: fresh anonymous loopback runtime per trial
runtime.container_runtime: not required; exact task verifiers replay in the maintained clean child-process harness

prompt: Read instruction.md, input.json, and submission_schema.json. Solve the task completely. Use the available Jacobian mathematical tools when useful. Write submission.json and every required evidence file in this workspace. Do not use the network or inspect files outside this workspace.

dataset.selection_rule: Preselected medium/hard tasks spanning direct witnesses, proof repair, large exact certificates, producer/checker use, and evidence-sensitive verification.

diagnostics.definition: The independent verifier reports mathematical correctness 1.0, regardless of protocol, evidence, scope, assurance, or aggregate reward.
Exact aggregate verifier reward equals 1.0. Direct reward and verifier-diagnostic fields are masked from predictors for this target.

x_y: predeclared task metadata and bounded file/shape counts
exact verifier diagnostics except fields masked for their own target
b: message count, byte count, truncation count, and redaction count
fixed case-insensitive lexicon counts: error, fail, retry, fallback, verify, checked, found, compute, wrote, complete, cannot, timeout
tau_tools: tool and capability-attempt counts and order

modeling.classifier: 3-nearest-neighbor with train-fold min-max scaling, deterministic majority and lexicographic tie breaks
modeling.split: leave-one-task-out; all prefix rows from one task remain in the held-out fold
modeling.uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed task-block bootstrap resamples of held-out predictions
task_identity_baselines: task-identity resubstitution upper bound, labeled non-generalizing and excluded from decisions

decision_rule.data_minimization: Eligible only if every eligible diagnostic has b incremental macro-F1 <= 0.02, the mean b increment is <= 0.01, tau_tools improves mean macro-F1 over x+y by >= 0.05, and the upper 95% task-bootstrap bound for mean b increment is <= 0.02.
decision_rule.preserve_b: Eligible only if b improves macro-F1 by >= 0.05 on at least two eligible diagnostics, improves the eligible-diagnostic mean by >= 0.03, and the lower 95% task-bootstrap bound for the mean increment is > 0.

fallback: After two failed methodological implementations, keep these frozen labels/features and use deterministic descriptive condition coverage plus exact contingency tables; do not tune a third predictive method on the same labels.

retention.committed_evidence: study contract, implementation/tests, aggregate report, counts, metrics, limitations, and SHA-256 bindings only
